description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map4_s01.i_shouldnt_have_left_you:
{wait1 4.0}I shouldn't have left you.
Things are worse than I thought.
strings.map4_s01.what_are_you_doing_here:
{wait1 3.0}What are you doing here?
I thought you left town.
strings.map4_s01.i_saw_you_go_in:
{wait1 2.8}I saw you go in here,
so I followed you.
strings.map4_s01.all_the_roads_out_of:
{wait1 2.0}All the roads out of town
are blocked.
strings.map4_s01.the_phones_and_radios_are:
{wait1 2.4}The phones and radios
are still out, too.{end}
strings.map4_s01.what_about_my_daughter_did:
{wait1 2.7}What about my daughter?
Did you see her?
strings.map4_s01.i_only_caught_a_glimpse:
{wait1 2.6}I only caught a glimpse of her
through the fog.
strings.map4_s01.i_went_after_her_but:
{wait1 2.4}I went after her,
but she vanished.
strings.map4_s01.i_dont_know_about_your:
{wait1 2.7}I don't know about
your daughter, but...{end}
strings.map4_s01.and_you_just_let_her:
{wait1 3.5}And you just let her go!?
Where was it?
strings.map4_s01.on_bachman_road_she_was:
{wait1 3.4}On Bachman Road.
She was heading towards the lake.
strings.map4_s01.it_wasnt_like_she_ran:
{wait1 2.5}It wasn't like she ran off
exactly.
strings.map4_s01.there_was_no_place_for:
{wait1 4.8}There was no place for her to go.
The road has been obliterated.{end}
strings.map4_s01.it_was_like_she_was:
{wait1 3.6}It was like she was walking
on thin air.
strings.map4_s01.her_names_dahlia_gillespie_do:
{wait1 4.0}Her name's Dahlia Gillespie.
Do you know her?
strings.map4_s01.she_said_something_about_the:
{wait1 4.0}She said something about
the town being devoured
by darkness.
strings.map4_s01.the_force_still_cant_figure:
{wait1 2.8}The force still can't figure out
who's behind it.
strings.map4_s01.none_of_our_leads_have:
{wait1 2.2}None of our leads
have panned out,
strings.map4_s01.what_could_drug_trafficking:
{wait1 3.5}What could drug trafficking
have to do with all this?
strings.map4_s01.but_maybe_thats_the_darkness:
{wait1 3.6}But, maybe that's the darkness
she was talking about.
strings.map4_s01.we_dont_know_whats_back:
{wait1 4.0}We don't know what's back there.
I'd better check it out first.
strings.map4_s01.if_anything_looks_fishy_get:
{wait1 3.6}If anything looks fishy,
get back here on the double.{end}
strings.map4_s01.well_like_some_other_world:
{wait1 6.2}Well...like some other world...
It's like some kind of bad dream...?
strings.map4_s01.i_try_to_make_sense:
{wait1 3.7}I try to make sense of it,
but then my mind goes blank.
strings.map4_s01.everythings_dark_there_and_i:
{wait1 4.0}Everything's dark there,
and I hear sirens in the distance.
strings.map4_s01.its_like_i_was_there:
{wait1 3.7}It's like I was there,
but not really.
strings.map4_s01.its_all_a_blur_like:
{wait1 4.2}It's all a blur.
Like some kind of hallucination,
you know?
strings.map4_s01.i_have_no_idea_what:
{wait1 3.0}I have no idea what
you're talking about, Harry.{end}
strings.map4_s01.some_kind_of_powder_is:
Some kind of powder
is left in the chalice.{end}
strings.map4_s01.there_is_a_trace_on:
There is a trace on the floor
that somebody moved the cabinet.
strings.map4_s01.do_you_want_to_push:
Do you want to push
the cabinet?{choice 4}
strings.map4_s01.but_maybe_this_is_all:
{wait 3.0}but maybe this is all just
going on in my head.
strings.map4_s01.i_could_have_had_a:
{wait 4.0}I could have had a car accident,
and now I'm lying unconscious
in a hospital bed...
strings.map4_s01.cybil_said_cheryl_was_heading:
{wait 3.0}Cybil said Cheryl was heading
towards the lake.
strings.map4_s01.but_the_road_to_the:
{wait 2.2}But, the road to the lake
is blocked...
strings.map4_s01.there_is_a_clock_nothing:
There is a clock.
Nothing special.{end}
strings.map4_s01.none_of_this_stuff_is: None of this stuff is of any use.{end}
strings.map4_s01.looks_like_an_altar_wonder:
Looks like an altar.
Wonder what they worship?{end}
